records.question: What is the estimated LAS project implementation cost for Fisheries Management?
Which committee initiated the American Samoa Local Action Strategies (LAS) process?
records.ground_truth_answer: The process was initiated through the American Samoa Coral Reef Advisory Group (CRAG), a voluntary committee comprised of numerous agencies and academic institutions in the territory concerned with coral reef issues.
ground_truth_chunks: This process was initiated through the American Samoa Coral Reef Advisory Group (CRAG), a voluntary committee comprised of numerous agencies and academic institutions in the territory concerned with coral reef issues.

Since its inception in 1998, CRAG has overseen many successful management and science activities, has increased member-agency collaboration and has improved alignment and cooperation with non-CRAG agencies that have common interests.
